severity_proxy.method: sigma from claim-weighted log policy-year average severity; mu re-centred so lognormal mean equals observed aggregate average severity

limitations: The dataset is an external public motor portfolio and is not automatically transferable to Togo, Mixx by Yas or the CIMA market.
Severity is observed as incurred amount aggregated by policy-year, not individual claim transactions.
Expense and commission ratios are not calibrated from this dataset and must not be inferred from premium/claim fields.
